ids_to_translations.translation: Tiny engines of strife and avarice, capable of plunging even the the most mundane patch of shoreline reeds into a sordid avian opera. Male marsh wrens' favourite pastimes are serial-mating, serial-infanticide, and mass production of decoy nests to thwart other marsh wrens' attempts at serial-infanticide. Presumably some of them, at some point, find the time to actually procreate their species.
